description: For each skill the authenticated user does NOT have, simulate adding it and compute the market impact. Pro tier. Returns a ranked list of skills with: newJobsUnlocked (jobs that previously didn't match but would after learning the skill), boostedJobs (existing matches that would score higher), companiesNeedingIt, relevantRoles, and a composite impactScore. Also returns profileCompleteness so the caller can suggest filling missing profile fields. Use for queries like 'what should I learn next?' or 'which skill would unlock the most jobs for me?'. Not for auditing the user's CURRENT skills against their target roles — use `skill_gap` for that.
name: skill_impact

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

data.description: Simulated market impact of skills the user could learn

currentMatchingJobs.description: Jobs matching the user's current skills in the sample

learnDisclosure.description: Affiliate-link disclosure text when learn links are present

message.description: Present when the profile has no skills yet

skillImpacts.description: Highest-impact skills to learn, ranked (capped at 10)

boostedJobs.description: Existing matches whose score would rise

impactScore.description: Composite ranking score (unlocked x3 + boosted + companies x2 + roles x5)

primary.description: Recommended course link (provider, url, title, free, ...)

newJobsUnlocked.description: Jobs that would newly match after learning it

relevantRoles.description: Desired-role titles that list it as required

topCompanies.description: Company domains needing the skill (capped at 5)

totalJobsAnalyzed.description: Size of the job sample simulated against

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: Skill Impact
